Hello beautiful dog people! 👋🐾

I'm Stephanie, a dog trainer specialising in rescue dogs, dogs adopted from abroad and bully breeds — and guardian to four rescue dogs of my own.

This channel is about understanding the dog in front of you: their behaviour, individual needs, experiences and the context around what they're doing.

You'll find practical videos about rescue dog life, behaviour and training, decompression, enrichment, confidence, living with dogs and all the messy bits that don't always fit neatly into a training tutorial.

I don't believe every dog needs the same recipe. I want to help you understand your dog, make informed decisions and build a life that works for both of you.

You'll also meet my own rescue dogs along the way — usually demonstrating that real life with dogs doesn't happen in a perfectly controlled training setup. 😅

New videos about rescue dogs, behaviour, training, enrichment and the humans living alongside them.

Welcome — I'm glad you're here. ❤️
